EmailTemplate.subject: We missed you at our “The Secret Weapon to Success in Insurance Distribution” webinar!

Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
We're sorry to have missed you at our webinar “The Secret Weapon to Success in Insurance Distribution."
In this webinar, Flywire's Matt Teumer, Kieran Brown of SIP Medical Family Office, and Andrew Jernigan of Insured Nomads discussed:
- How they are enhancing operational efficiency and strengthening carrier-broker relationships - How to attract and retain customers in a competitive environment - How strategic collaborations in payments can revolutionize your insurance distribution strategy
Watch the recording here <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-the-secret-weapon-to-success-in-insurance-distribution?mkt_tok=MzcyLVFTUS02NDkAAAGUQloBtWfTC3joowk6sX3PcH9j-QaSO5WaKwq_Y2mIp54PrXAiz73NUF9P-Z-JoOqC9BmECf30kzKL77oXywY]]>.
Need more information or have questions? Please reach out to Matt Teumer: matt.teumer@flywire.com <[[https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/?fs=1&tf=cm&source=mailto&to=matt.teumer@flywire.com]]>.
Thank you! The Flywire Team Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
